### Dimensionality reduction
We normalize and scale the data, identify the most variable features and perform dimensionality reduction.

```{r}
obj <- NormalizeData(obj)
obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
# scaling SOLO sui geni variabili
obj <- ScaleData(obj, features = VariableFeatures(obj))
# PCA sui geni variabili
obj <- RunPCA(obj, features = VariableFeatures(obj), npcs = 30)
ElbowPlot(obj)
obj <- RunUMAP(obj, dims = 1:15)
saveRDS(obj, "/home/drighelli/lncRNA_project/OUT/OLD_CRC/merged_normalized_hvgs_3.Rds")
```

### Cell type annotation

The original dataset provides the cell type annotations. We aimed to interdependently validate this labeling by re-performing unsupervised cell type annotation (scMRMA + PanglaoDB).

#### 1A

# DimPlot(obj, group.by="Cell_type", cols=kelly()[c(3, 7, 4, 5, 6, 8)], label = T, label.box = T, label.color = "white") + ggtitle("") + theme(legend.position = "none")
DimPlot(obj, group.by="Cell_type", cols=kelly()[c(3, 7, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9)], label = T, label.box = T, label.color = "white") + ggtitle("") + theme(legend.position = "none")
#ggsave("OUT/1A. UMAP.cell type.pdf", width = 10, height = 9, units = "cm")

#| warning: false

#nel codice originale la matrice usata è quella non normalizzata, noi usiamo quella normalizzata

# Controllo dei layer disponibili nell'assay RNA
Layers(obj[["RNA"]])

# NON usare scale.data per scMRMA (è troppo trasformato e instabile)
# norm_mat = LayerData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "scale.data")

# Usa invece il data layer (log-normalized expression)
obj <- JoinLayers(obj)
logcounts <- GetAssayData(obj, layer = "data")

# (opzionale) assicurati che il default assay sia corretto
DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RNA"

# Salvo l'oggetto Seurat completo (merge + annotazioni + metadata)
saveRDS(obj, file = "OUT/normalizedObject.rds")

# NON salvare scale.data come matrice per scMRMA
# saveRDS(norm_mat, file = "OUT/norm_mat.rds")

# NON ricaricare la matrice appena salvata (era ridondante e creava confusione)
# logcounts = readRDS("OUT/norm_mat.rds")

# Esegui scMRMA sull'oggetto completo
result <- scMRMA(input = logcounts, species = "Hs", normalizedData = TRUE)

obj$scMRMA_annotation <- result$multiR$annotationResult[colnames(obj), 1]

obj[["cell_type1"]] <- result$multiR$annotationResult[colnames(obj),1]

df <- as.data.frame(table(obj$Cell_type, obj$cell_type1))
colnames(df) <- c("Original","Validation","Fraction")

ggplot(df, aes(x=Original, y=Fraction, fill=Validation)) + geom_bar(stat="identity", position = "fill") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = kelly()[c(6,7, 3,5,8)]) + theme_bw() + coord_flip()

### Cell type specificity

We used gencode annotation to identify the lncRNAs and protein coding genes which are measured in the scRNA-seq data. We then compared the cell type specificity between protein coding and lncRNA genes estimating the Gini Coefficient.

# =========================
# LOAD OBJECT
# =========================
obj <- readRDS("OUT/merged_3.Rds")

DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RNA"
obj <- JoinLayers(obj)
obj <- NormalizeData(obj)

Idents(obj) <- "Cell_type"

# =========================
# GENCODE ANNOTATION
# =========================
gencode <- read.table("DATA/gencode_v49.txt", header = TRUE)

lnc  <- gencode[gencode$type == "lncRNA", ]
prot <- gencode[gencode$type == "protein_coding", ]

# =========================
# GENE MATCHING (RAW)
# =========================
genes_obj <- rownames(obj)

# raw matches
lnc_raw  <- intersect(genes_obj, lnc$SYMBOL)
prot_raw <- intersect(genes_obj, prot$SYMBOL)

# =========================
# DEBUG BLOCK: TRACK MISSING GENES
# =========================

# genes classified as lnc before filtering
# lnc_before_filter <- unique(lnc_raw)

# genes overlapping protein coding
ambiguous_genes <- intersect(lnc_raw, prot_raw)

# current filtering logic (kept identical)
# lnc_features <- (unique(lnc_raw), prot_raw)
lnc_features <- unique(lnc_raw)
prot_features <- unique(prot_raw)

# KEY STEP: identify lost genes (THE "9 MISSING")
# lost_genes <- setdiff(lnc_before_filter, lnc_features)

cat("\n================ DEBUG ================\n")
cat("lnc raw:", length(lnc_raw), "\n")
cat("prot raw:", length(prot_raw), "\n")
cat("ambiguous:", length(ambiguous_genes), "\n")
cat("lnc after filter:", length(lnc_features), "\n")
# cat("LOST GENES:", length(lost_genes), "\n")
cat("======================================\n")

intersect(lnc_features, prot_features)

#lost_genes
gencode %>%
  filter(SYMBOL %in% ambiguous_genes) %>%
  group_by(SYMBOL) %>%
  summarise(types = paste(unique(type), collapse = ", "))

# =========================
# GINI FUNCTION (DotPlot-based)
# =========================
compute_gini_dotplot <- function(features_chunk) {
  dp <- DotPlot(obj, features = features_chunk)
  df <- dp$data
  
  df <- df[, c("features.plot", "pct.exp")]
  
  out <- aggregate(pct.exp ~ features.plot, df, function(x) Gini(x))
  
  colnames(out) <- c("gene", "gini")
  return(out)
}

# =========================
# PARAMETERS
# =========================
chunk_size <- 1000

# =========================
# lncRNA GINI
# =========================
chunks_lnc <- split(lnc_features,
                    ceiling(seq_along(lnc_features)/chunk_size))

Gini_list_lnc <- lapply(chunks_lnc, compute_gini_dotplot)

GiniCoef_lnc <- do.call(rbind, Gini_list_lnc)
GiniCoef_lnc$type <- "lncRNA"

# =========================
# protein coding GINI
# =========================
chunks_prot <- split(prot_features,
                     ceiling(seq_along(prot_features)/chunk_size))

Gini_list_prot <- lapply(chunks_prot, compute_gini_dotplot)

GiniCoef_prot <- do.call(rbind, Gini_list_prot)
GiniCoef_prot$type <- "protein_coding"

# =========================
# MERGE FINAL DATASET
# =========================
GiniCoef <- rbind(GiniCoef_lnc, GiniCoef_prot)
colnames(GiniCoef)[1] <- "gene"

saveRDS(GiniCoef, "OUT/gini_dotplot_v49.Rds")


# =========================
# CLEAN DATA
# =========================
GiniCoef <- readRDS("OUT/gini_dotplot.Rds")
# Pulizia RAM
rm(obj,
   Gini_list_lnc, Gini_list_prot,
   chunks_lnc, chunks_prot,
   lnc_features, prot_features,
   lnc_raw, prot_raw)

gc()
GiniCoef_clean <- GiniCoef[!is.na(GiniCoef$gini), ]

# =========================
# COUNTS
# =========================
lnc_n  <- nrow(GiniCoef_clean %>% filter(type == "lncRNA"))
prot_n <- nrow(GiniCoef_clean %>% filter(type == "protein_coding"))

# =========================
# PLOT
# =========================
ggplot(GiniCoef_clean, aes(x = type, y = gini, fill = type)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  stat_compare_means(hjust = 0) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = kelly()[c(12,9)]) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  annotate(
    x = c("lncRNA", "protein_coding"),
    y = c(0.84, 0.57),
    label = c(
      paste0("(n = ", lnc_n, ")"),
      paste0("(n = ", prot_n, ")")
    ),
    col = "black",
    size = 4,
    geom = "text"
  )

# =========================
# CHECK CASC19 
# =========================

gene <- "CASC19"

# 1) presenza nel dataset
gene %in% rownames(obj)

# 2) espressione media per cell type (coerente con Seurat v5)
AverageExpression(obj, features = gene)$RNA

# 3) visualizzazione cell-type specificity
DotPlot(obj, features = gene) +
  RotatedAxis()

# 4) Gini coerente con pipeline (NO LayerData, NO errori di sessione)
df_casc <- DotPlot(obj, features = gene)$data

df_casc <- df_casc[, c("features.plot", "pct.exp")]

casc_gini <- aggregate(pct.exp ~ features.plot, df_casc, Gini)

colnames(casc_gini) <- c("celltype", "gini")

casc_gini

### Epithelial lncRNAs
#We performed differential expression to identify the lncRNAs which are significantly (adjusted pvalue < 0.01) enriched in the epithelial cells.

Idents(obj) <- "Cell_type"

gencode <- read.table("DATA/gencode_v49.txt", header = TRUE, sep="\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Filtra solo lncRNA presenti nell'oggetto
lnc <- filter(gencode, type == "lncRNA")
lnc <- lnc[lnc$SYMBOL %in% rownames(obj), ]
lnc_genes <- unique(lnc$SYMBOL)

# DotPlot Seurat v5
lnc_percent <- DotPlot(obj, features = lnc_genes)$data

# FindMarkers per le cellule epiteliali
obj <- JoinLayers(obj)
Idents(obj) <- "Cell_type"
M <- FindMarkers(
  object = obj,
  ident.1 = "Epithelial cells",
  only.pos = TRUE,
  min.pct = 0,
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  features = lnc_genes
)
M <- subset(M, p_val_adj < 0.01)

# Filtra DotPlot per geni significativi
lnc_percent2 <- subset(lnc_percent, features.plot %in% rownames(M))
lnc_percent2$id <- factor(
  lnc_percent2$id,
  levels = c("B cells", "Epithelial cells", "Mast cells", "Myeloids", "Stromal cells", "T cells")
)


#### 1C - Density plot of example epithelial lncRNA
obj_umap <- readRDS("OUT/merged_normalized_hvgs_3.Rds")
# Verifica che "LINC00523" sia presente nel dataset
example_gene <- if("LINC00523" %in% rownames(obj[["RNA"]])) {
  "LINC00523"
} else {
  # Se non esiste, prendi il primo gene significativo identificato in M
  rownames(M)[1]
}

plot_density(obj_umap, features = example_gene)
#ggsave("OUT/1C. Epithelial.lncRNAs.example.pdf", width = 10, height = 9, units = "cm")

#### 1D
ggplot(lnc_percent2, aes(x=reorder(id, avg.exp.scaled), y=avg.exp.scaled, fill=id)) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = kelly()[c(3,7,4,5,6,8)]) +

## Integration with TCGA data
# We accessed the COAD TCGA data via the GEPIA2 webserver and performed differential expression analysis between tumor and normal samples. Integrating these results with the epithelial lncRNAs we identified 77 upregulated epithelial lncRNAs, 11 of which show minimal expression in normal samples.

#### 2A
COAD <- read.table("DATA/coad.tcga.txt", header = TRUE)
lnc <- filter(gencode, type == "lncRNA")
COAD <- filter(COAD, Gene %in% lnc$SYMBOL)

x <- list(
  COAD$Gene[COAD$log2FC > 0],
  COAD$Gene[COAD$log2FC < 0],
  rownames(M)
)
names(x) <- c("TCGA-Up","TCGA-Down","Epithelial")

ggvenn(
  x,
  fill_color = c(viridis(11)[c(11,1)], kelly()[7]),
  show_percentage = FALSE,
  stroke_size = 0.5,
  set_name_size = 4,
  fill_alpha = 0.85
) +
  ggtitle("TCGA - Epithelial lncRNAs overlap") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face="bold"))
#ggsave("OUT/2A. Epithelial.lncRNAs.TCGA.venn.pdf", width = 10, height = 9, units = "cm")


#### 2B
COAD <- filter(COAD, Gene %in% rownames(M))

ggplot(COAD, aes(x=reorder(Gene, log2FC), y=log2FC, fill=log2FC)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(midpoint=0, low=viridis(3)[1], high=viridis(3)[3]) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("LncRNAs") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size=6))
#ggsave("OUT/2B. Epithelial.lncRNAs.TCGA.DEGs.pdf", width = 10, height = 20, units = "cm")


#### 2C
ggplot(COAD, aes(x=log(Tumor+0.001), y=log(Normal+0.001))) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw() +
  ylab("log(Normal Expression)") +
  xlab("log(Tumor Expression)") +
  geom_label_repel(
    nudge_y = 3,
    nudge_x = 0.5,
    color = kelly()[7],
    fill = "white",
    max.overlaps = 100000,
    size = 2,
    label = ifelse(COAD$Normal == 0, COAD$Gene, "")
  )
